title: Hallucination-Free GUI Grounding via Regression-Free Layout-Aware Matching
abstract: arXiv:2608.09654v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: GUI agents are shifting from metadata-dependent large language models to purely visual multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that operate directly on screenshots. The core task, GUI grounding, requires translating abstract user instructions into precise element coordinates. This task faces a persistent dual obstacle: conventional grounding models lack the semantic richness to interpret abstract instructions, while end-to-end MLLMs suffer from coordinate hallucinations caused by deficient fine-grained perception. A frozen MLLM first elaborates the abstract instruction into a structured visual description rich in layout cues. translated_title: 基于无回归布局感知匹配的无幻觉GUI定位
translated_abstract: GUI智能体正在从依赖元数据的大型语言模型转向直接在屏幕截图上操作的纯视觉多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）。核心任务GUI定位（GUI grounding）需要将抽象的用户指令转化为精确的元素坐标。这项任务面临一个持续存在的双重障碍：传统定位模型缺乏解读抽象指令所需的语义丰富性，而端到端MLLM则因细粒度感知能力不足而遭受坐标幻觉问题。我们提出了一个无回归框架，其中冻结的MLLM负责指令解析，专用定位模型负责精确定位，而无需学习任何坐标回归。冻结的MLLM首先将抽象指令细化为富含布局线索的结构化视觉描述，这些描述随后被输入到一个新颖的布局感知GUI定位模型中，该模型执行无回归定位。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无回归框架，利用冻结的MLLM将抽象指令解析为富含布局线索的结构化视觉描述，再通过布局感知匹配实现无坐标回归、无幻觉的精确GUI元素定位。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a regression-free framework where a frozen MLLM elaborates abstract instructions into layout-rich structured visual descriptions, enabling hallucination-free GUI element localization via layout-aware matching without coordinate regression.
